quest.minecraft:spawner.title: Chapter: Apothic Spawners
quest.minecraft:spawner.quest_subtitle: Capture, modify and weaponize monster spawners.
quest.minecraft:spawner.quest_desc: &7Open the &eApothic Spawners&7 chapter to master the secret art of taming spawners.
&7Learn how to use the &bSilk Spell&7 to harvest spawners, swap their entity with &eSpawn Eggs&7, and upgrade them with modifier items to boost spawn rate, range and player checks.
&eTip:&r Most hostile mobs are blacklisted server-side. Check the wiki before farming.
quest.minecraft:enchanting_table.title: Chapter: Apothic Enchanting
quest.minecraft:enchanting_table.quest_d: &7Open the &eApothic Enchanting&7 chapter to unlock the deepest enchantments in Arcadia.
&7Build a true power-room with custom shelves (&cHellshelf&7, &5Soulshelf&7, &dEndshelf&7, &6Treasure Shelf&7) to raise &bEterna&7, &dArcana&7 and &eQuanta&7.
&eTip:&r Place a &6Statue of the Mage&7 to reroll your top enchant for free.
quest.aquaculture:diamond_fishing_rod.qu: Master rivers, oceans and rare catches.
&7Open the &bAquaculture&7 chapter to turn fishing into a real progression branch.
&7Craft better rods (wooden -> diamond -> neptunium), use specialized &eBait&7, and catch dozens of new fish species, hidden loot crates and even legendary tridents.
&eTip:&r Fish in biome-specific waters at night for the rarest drops.
quest.immersiveengineering:hammer.title: Chapter: Immersive Engineering
quest.immersiveengineering:hammer.quest_: &7Open the &6Immersive Engineering&7 chapter to build classic 1900s-style factories.
&7Use the &eEngineer's Hammer&7 to rotate machines, connect &bwire connectors&7 with copper/steel wires, and power multiblocks like the &cBlast Furnace&7, &eExcavator&7 and &6Arc Furnace&7.
&eTip:&r The Engineer's Manual is your best friend — keep it on your hotbar.
quest.minecraft:netherrack.title: Chapter: The Nether
quest.minecraft:netherrack.quest_subtitl: Burn, dig and survive the red dimension.
quest.minecraft:netherrack.quest_desc: &7Open the &cNether&7 chapter to track every milestone of the burning realm.
&7Light a portal, hunt &eBlazes&7, harvest &6Ancient Debris&7, trade with &dPiglins&7 and defeat the &cWither&7. Many late-game recipes need Nether-only ingredients.
&eTip:&r Bring &bFire Resistance&7 potions and gold armor before stepping in.
quest.minecraft:crafting_table.title: Chapter: Getting Started
quest.minecraft:crafting_table.quest_sub: Your first steps in Arcadia V2.
quest.minecraft:crafting_table.quest_des: &7Open the &eGetting Started&7 chapter to learn the basics of the modpack.
&7Punch wood, craft a workbench, build a shelter, eat food and survive the first night. This chapter holds your hand through every essential vanilla step.
&eTip:&r Read the &6Arcadia Welcome Book&7 from your spawn inventory first.
quest.create:wrench.title: Chapter: Create
quest.create:wrench.quest_desc: &7Open the &6Create&7 chapter to master the kinetic engineering mod.
&7Build &eWater Wheels&7, &bWindmills&7 and &cSteam Engines&7 to generate Stress Units, then power &eMechanical Crafters&7, &dPresses&7 and full assembly lines.
&eTip:&r Use the &6Wrench&7 to rotate, dismantle and reconfigure any Create block.
quest.mekanism:configurator.title: Chapter: Mekanism
quest.mekanism:configurator.quest_subtit: Industrial tech, ore tripling and MekaSuit.
quest.mekanism:configurator.quest_desc: &7Open the &bMekanism&7 chapter for the full industrial-tech progression.
&7Climb the tier ladder &eBasic -> Advanced -> Elite -> Ultimate&7, multiply your ore output up to ×5, automate with Factories, and build the legendary &6MekaSuit&7.
&eTip:&r The &eConfigurator&7 sets every machine's I/O sides in seconds.
quest.irons_spellbooks:scroll.title: Chapter: Iron's Spells & Spellbooks
quest.irons_spellbooks:scroll.quest_desc: &7Open the &dIron's Spellbooks&7 chapter to walk the path of magic.
&7Learn spells from &eScrolls&7, bind them into &bSpellbooks&7, and specialize in &cFire&7, &bIce&7, &fHoly&7, &5Eldritch&7, &2Nature&7 or &8Blood&7 schools.
&eTip:&r Each spell school has its own armor set giving +tier and -cooldown.
quest.aether:aether_portal_frame.title: Chapter: The Aether
quest.aether:aether_portal_frame.quest_s: Soar through the floating sky dimension.
quest.aether:aether_portal_frame.quest_d: &7Open the &bAether&7 chapter to explore the legendary heavenly dimension.
&7Build a &eGlowstone&7 frame, douse it with &9Water&7, and discover floating islands, &dValkyries&7, &6Bronze Dungeons&7 and the precious &eGravitite&7 ore.
&eTip:&r Falling out of the Aether throws you back to the Overworld — bring a &fCloud Parachute&7.
quest.deeperdarker:heart_of_the_deep.que: &7Open the &8Deeper & Darker&7 chapter to brave the Otherside.
&7Survive &3Sculk&7 biomes, awaken the &cWarden&7, harvest &bEcho&7 and &3Sculk Crystals&7, and craft the dreaded &8Soul Elytra&7.
&cWarning:&r The Warden is a one-shot threat — sneak, no sprint, no projectile noise.
quest.minecraft:end_portal_frame.title: Chapter: The End
quest.minecraft:end_portal_frame.quest_s: Slay the Dragon, then keep going.
quest.minecraft:end_portal_frame.quest_d: &7Open the &5End&7 chapter for the late-game dragon arc.
&7Find the Stronghold, defeat the &dEnder Dragon&7, harvest &dEnd Cities&7, loot &dElytras&7 and tame &5Shulkers&7. Many magic mods need End-only ingredients.
&eTip:&r Bring beds for the dragon — they still hold the highest DPS in vanilla.
quest.mekanismgenerators:fission_reactor: &7Open the &aNuclear&7 chapter to build Mekanism's endgame power plants.
&7Enrich uranium, assemble a &cFission Reactor&7, cool it with sodium, then chain a &bTurbine&7 and a &6Fusion Reactor&7 for millions of FE/t.
&cWarning:&r A meltdown will irradiate your entire base — always plan a coolant loop.
quest.fluxnetworks:flux_core.title: Chapter: Flux Networks
quest.fluxnetworks:flux_core.quest_desc: &7Open the &eFlux Networks&7 chapter to ditch cables forever.
&7Craft a &6Flux Plug&7 on your generators and a &bFlux Point&7 on your machines, link them to the same network, and watch energy teleport across worlds.
&eTip:&r The &dFlux Controller&7 raises transfer limits and lets you bridge dimensions.
quest.immersive_aircraft:gyrodyne.title: Chapter: Immersive Aircraft
quest.immersive_aircraft:gyrodyne.quest_: &7Open the &bImmersive Aircraft&7 chapter to build personal flying machines.
&7Assemble &eBiplanes&7, &6Gyrodynes&7, &dQuadrocopters&7 and majestic &fAirships&7 — each with its own fuel, speed and cargo capacity.
&eTip:&r Aircraft can be parked, locked and even &eboarded&7 by your friends.
quest.artifacts:mimic_spawn_egg.title: Chapter: Artifacts & Loot
quest.artifacts:mimic_spawn_egg.quest_su: Curiosity items hidden in the world.
quest.artifacts:mimic_spawn_egg.quest_de: &7Open the &dArtifacts&7 chapter to hunt powerful curio trinkets.
&7Each &6Artifact&7 is a passive accessory: belts, gloves, necklaces, charms... obtained from dungeon chests or by killing the dreaded &cMimic&7.
&eTip:&r Equip artifacts in the &bCurios&7 slots (press &eC&7 to open the menu).
quest.occultism:spirit_fire.title: Chapter: Occultism
quest.occultism:spirit_fire.quest_desc: &7Open the &5Occultism&7 chapter to summon entities from the spirit realm.
&7Light &dSpirit Fire&7, draw chalk pentagrams, perform &cRituals&7 to summon &eDjinns&7, &5Foliots&7 and &8Afrits&7, and bind them as familiars or workers.
&eTip:&r Spirits can store storage, mine ores, craft items, even brew potions for you.
quest.simplyswords:tampered_remnant.ques: &7Open the &6Simply Swords&7 chapter to craft exotic blades.
&7Discover &eKatanas&7, &dGreatswords&7, &bRapiers&7, &cClaymores&7 and &fScythes&7 — each with unique stamina-based special attacks bound to &eAlt&7.
&eTip:&r The &6Empowered Remnant&7 is the legendary endgame material — only drops from special bosses.
